2608.28329.title: BanglaMed-QA: A Question Answering System for Healthcare Support in Bangla
2608.28329.paper_summary: Medical question answering (QA) systems have become crucial tools for providing reliable health information. But they remain very unexplored for low-resource languages like Bangla due to limited datasets and systems tailored to these languages. To address this, we introduce BanglaMed-QA, a robust QA system specifically designed for the Bangla medical domain. The process begins with building a structured medical knowledge base that includes 4,493 QA pairs in 9 categories under 506 diseases. To improve semantic comprehension, domain-specific root word dictionaries and synonym sets are proposed, in addition to part-of-speech tagging for anaphora resolution. We adopt supervised machine learning models in which SVM is found to be the best model to categorize questions. Multiple similarity metrics, including cosine, Jaccard, BM25, and Levenshtein, are applied with soft and hard voting methods for query matching. The performance of the QA system has been evaluated in two aspects, with a 95% F1 score in an automated evaluation and an average human satisfaction rating of 0.9 out of 1.0. This validates the real-world application of BanglaMed-QA in closing the healthcare information gap for Bangla speakers.
2608.28329.paper_summary_zh: 醫療問答（QA）系統已成為提供可靠健康資訊的重要工具。<lb/>但由於缺乏針對這些語言的數據集和系統，低資源語言如孟加拉語仍然未被充分探索。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們推出了BanglaMed-QA，一個專門為孟加拉醫療領域設計的強大QA系統。<lb/>該過程始於建立一個結構化的醫療知識庫，包括在506種疾病下的9個類別中的4,493個QA對。<lb/>為了改善語義理解，除了針對指代解析的詞性標註外，還提出了特定領域的根詞字典和同義詞集。<lb/>我們採用監督式機器學習模型，其中SVM被發現是分類問題的最佳模型。<lb/>多種相似度度量，包括餘弦相似度、Jaccard、BM25和Levenshtein，與軟投票和硬投票方法一起應用於查詢匹配。<lb/>QA系統的性能在兩個方面進行了評估，自動評估中的F1分數為95%，人類滿意度平均評分為0.9（滿分1.0）。<lb/>這驗證了BanglaMed-QA在填補孟加拉語使用者的醫療資訊空白方面的實際應用。
